schema_note: Every number is {value, unit, confidence, source, method (if estimated)}. confidence: CONFIRMED = read from an official OEM or government document; ESTIMATED = planning value, derived figure or non-official source (aggregator, dealer, archive) used as a lead; UNKNOWN = not found, value null. x positions are measured along the vehicle from the front axle centre, positive forward. Internal dimensions are design estimates used to build the GLBs, not measurements (see data/interior_confidence_report.md and research/reports/report_interior_measurements.md).

glb_convention.origin: Mid-length of the body (x = overall length / 2 from the nose), on the vehicle centreline, at ground level (y = 0). NOT at the front axle.
glb_convention.front_axle_offset: Front axle centre is at x = +(L/2 − front overhang) in each GLB; see glb_build_values.front_axle_x_in_glb_m. Subtract it from x to get the requested front-axle origin.
